question: Where does each FORTRESS America base project stand on the proof ladder?
answer: Of the 10 base projects the FORTRESS registry tracks, only MCAS Miramar microgrid has a public island test; 4 have public operating descriptions with different boundaries, 4 are at selection or negotiation, 1 is a prototype, and FORTRESS itself has no published site list, definition or funding yet.

sections.title: The proof ladder
sections.sub: What record is needed at each step, and where the package places FORTRESS sites. On a phone, swipe sideways.

rows.text: P0 · Direction
Official direction or program announcement.
FORTRESS America is here: a real program exists, but implementation is not yet fixed.
P1 · Scope fixed
Named installation, electrical boundary, mission loads, duration and performance standard.
This is the first missing FORTRESS-wide receipt.
P2 · Authority and money fixed
Appropriation, obligation or executed agreement naming the accountable owner and operator.
Conditional selection and FYDP alignment do not reach this state.
P3 · Design and permission fixed
Accepted architecture, interconnection, cyber controls and required license or authorization.
A vendor pairing or notice to negotiate remains earlier than this state.
P4 · Built
Physical completion with material deficiencies identified or closed.
Construction completion still does not prove integrated operation.
P5 · Commissioned
Accepted integrated system delivering power to its defined loads.
Yuma, New London, McCoy and Sigonella have public operating descriptions with different boundaries.
P6 · Island tested
Observed no-grid start, transfer and carriage of a defined load.
Miramar has public mission-critical islanding evidence; that is not automatically a full-load endurance test.
P7 · Endurance and recovery tested
Required load carried for the required duration, followed by safe recovery or resynchronization.
Stated 14- or 21-day design capability is not the same as an observed test.
P8 · Recurring readiness
Repeated exercise, maintenance, fuel, staffing and exception evidence.
This is the durable portfolio outcome FORTRESS ultimately needs.

uncertain: A stated 14- or 21-day design capability is not an observed test; the package says an independence claim is only as strong as its load boundary, duration and operating-test record.
The projects have different boundaries (full base, critical load, a gate, a tenant facility), so they are not counted toward one readiness score.

The full saved FORTRESS source ledger is available. It lists controlling, framework and project sources with their authority, access state and limits; the signed memorandum remains under the September 30 access hold.

Source gap (package README): The official release links the signed memorandum, but the publisher PDF was not retrievable through the available browser, HTTP or PDF-reader paths on September 30. Search indexing exposed the memorandum text and a secondary mirror reproduced it, but this package keeps the memorandum in official_link_access_hold state. The accessible official release controls the confirmed public announcement; memorandum-only wording must be rechecked against the signed PDF before quotation.
